answer: Bind every new identity to a decaying admission cost. A fresh key must burn real compute before its first whisper is heard, and the difficulty is keyed to the epoch hash so it cannot be pre-mined or bought in bulk. Cheap clones then pile up as unspent ember of unrealised potential: funded, waiting, and unable to act until each pays its own price. Over many epochs the graph drifts like a dune, aggregate only to whatever real capacity its owners are willing to keep burning.
